note: Long Division Magic: forty-eight inside, four outside, one digit at a time with two aligned subtractions. Quiz: read the finished layout and pick the quotient / finish a half-written quotient / find the long division that has a mistake.

lines.text: Let's write long division. Forty-eight inside, four outside.
Four divided by four is one. Write one on top.
One times four is four. Four minus four is zero.
Bring down the eight. Eight divided by four is two.
Two times four is eight. Eight minus eight is zero.
Forty-eight divided by four is twelve!
Eighty-four divided by four. Finish the quotient.
Sixty-nine divided by three. Finish the quotient.
Ninety-six divided by three. Finish the quotient.
Which long division has a mistake?
